topics.title_zh: Cloudflare表示，它为所有免费和付费客户默认部署了WAF缓解措施，以对抗两个PHP漏洞，大约在公开披露前9个小时（Cloudflare）。
topics.title_en: Cloudflare says it deployed WAF mitigations for all free and paid tier customers to combat two PHP flaws by default, about nine hours ahead of public disclosure (Cloudflare)
topics.summary_zh: Today, Calif.io, Wiz, OpenAI and Quarkslab disclosed two vulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and known as php2shell. The vulnerabilities affect all web servers running PHP 5.4 or later
topics.summary_en: Cloudflare deployed default WAF mitigations for all free and paid tier customers approximately nine hours ahead of the public disclosure of two critical PHP vulnerabilities known as php2shell. This coordinated action was triggered because the exploits leaked prematurely and attackers were actively targeting web servers.

topics.title_zh: 锁定下一代芯片：Anthropic洽谈四百五十亿算力大单
topics.title_en: Sources: Nscale is in talks for a second deal with Anthropic worth ~$45B to deliver 460MW of computing power at its West Virginia campus using Vera Rubin chips (Bloomberg)
topics.summary_zh: 算力云服务商Nscale正与Anthropic洽谈总额约450亿美元的算力采购协议
topics.summary_en: AI hyperscale cloud provider Nscale is in advanced discussions with Anthropic on a second computing supply contract valued at approximately $45 billion. The massive deal entails supplying 460 megawatts of power capacity at Nscale's West Virginia campus powered by Nvidia's upcoming Vera Rubin architecture. By securing ultra-rare future silicon allocations and corresponding utility interconnects years ahead, Anthropic is locking in an insurmountable compute moat.

perspective_pro.point_en: Next-gen frontier intelligence requires astronomical dedicated compute; leveraging debt for massive TPU clusters is the necessary entry fee for AGI.

topics.title_zh: 深度求索开源极速推理引擎破局成本战
topics.title_en: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
topics.summary_zh: 深度求索开源支撑其极速模型的核心推理引擎，通过大幅削减算力与能耗成本加剧全球大模型价格战
topics.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the inference engine powering its ultra-fast and cost-effective V4.1-Flash model. The system drastically slashes compute expenditures and operational energy consumption, exerting immediate downward pricing pressure on Western frontier AI rivals.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 开源赋能派 / 独立开发者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 开源贡献者与视效创作者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 高能效蒸馏与自我反馈强化学习显著压缩了推断成本，视效运镜控制让普通创作者也能享受到工业级生成能力。
perspective_pro.point_en: Reinforcement learning and efficient distillation drastically slash token costs, empowering indie creators with production-grade video and reasoning.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 落地清醒派 / 商业审慎者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 传统视效导演与企业产品总监
perspective_con.point_zh: 榜单与跑分繁荣不等于真实业务闭环，当前模型在物理一致性与高阶企业级生产场景中仍存在不可忽视的稳定性瓶颈。
perspective_con.point_en: Benchmark leaps do not guarantee enterprise product-market fit; temporal consistency and commercial workflow integrations remain non-trivial bottlenecks.
